ContentRef.description:
Where a large or sensitive body lives: `event_content.hash` (xxh3-128
hex) and its length. Retention may delete the body; the ref stays.

size.description: The whole body's length, stored or not.

truncated.description: Only the first part was stored (bodies are capped).

description:
`ui.op_failed@1` (tsk1072): an operation the person started in the
app failed, as the app showed it (`oxplow.ui.report_error`). Its captured
stderr and stdout are the `output` body.

command.description: The command it ran, shell-style ("git merge bugfixes").

duration_ms.description: How long it ran, in milliseconds.

label.description: What the person was doing ("Merge bugfixes into current").

message.description: The error message, when there was no captured output to show.

signal.description: The signal that killed the process (`SIGKILL`).

thread.description: The thread it was started from (`thr3`).

title: UiOpFailedV1
